headline: God of War Laufey release date confirmed
title: God of War Laufey Release Date February 16 2027 | PS5 | Gaming News
video_script: The next God of War has a release date. God of War Laufey launches on February sixteenth, twenty twenty seven, exclusively on PlayStation 5. It's made by Santa Monica Studio, it will be available on disc, and pre-orders opened on September twenty ninth. For the first time in a mainline God of War game, you won't play as Kratos. You play as Faye. Are you buying it on day one? Comment below!
description: God of War Laufey launches February 16, 2027 exclusively on PS5. Developed by Santa Monica Studio, available on disc, pre-orders opened September 29, 2026. You play as Faye, not Kratos.
tags: God of War Laufey release date
